title: §.XIII open: Distinction from §.XII decides two questions — Reformati AC Socii? Religious Peace participants?
pass_a_gloss: §. XIII. By the aid of the Distinction handed down in the preceding §.XII, it is easy to decide, and to detect as decided either justly or nefariously, the pair of Theological-Historical Questions: Whether the Reformed are Associates of the Augsburg Confession? and, Whether the same are to be held participants of the Religious Peace?
pass_b_english: §. XIII. With the distinction given in §.XII above, it is easy to settle — and to see whether the settlement was just or wicked — this pair of theological-historical questions:
Are the Reformed associates of the Augsburg Confession? And are they to be counted participants in the Religious Peace?
source_text:
§. XIII.
Ope Distinctionis, superiori §.XII traditae, in facili est decidere, & vel justè, vel nefariè, decisam deprehendere Quaestionum Theologico-Historicarum bigam: Utrum Reformati Augustanae Confessionis Socii? &, Utrum Pacis Religiosae participes iidem habendi?

choices.why: two linked questions, not a vague set
